offensiveAbilities.name: Appendage Cluster
offensiveAbilities.description:
A caypin's detached appendage cluster is a Small, mindless, semi-independent creature controlled by the caypin. It has the minion trait, darkvision, 30 Healing Damage Hit Points, a land Speed of 20 feet, and a swim Speed of 15 feet. It shares the caypin's AC, saving throw bonuses, and skill modifiers. The caypin can see what its appendage cluster sees and otherwise shares its senses with the cluster. Each round, the caypin can Command a Minion to grant an appendage cluster 2 actions. An appendage cluster can make jaws Strikes (Melee ◆ jaws +14, Damage 2d4+3 piercing) and has the Cluster Onslaught ability.

If the caypin is killed, any detached appendage clusters are also killed. Any appendage cluster that moves more than 100 feet from the caypin dies instantly.

If both the caypin's detached appendage clusters are destroyed but the caypin still lives, the caypin is Blinded until it regrows at least one of its appendage clusters. A dead appendage cluster regrows in 3 days.

offensiveAbilities.name: Aquatic Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
40 feet

Requirements The monster is hiding in water and a creature that hasn't detected it is within the listed number of feet

Effect The monster moves up to its swim Speed + 10 feet toward the triggering creature, traveling on water and on land. Once the creature is in reach, the monster makes a Strike against it. The creature is Off-Guard against this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cluster Onslaught
offensiveAbilities.description: An appendage cluster attempts an Acrobatics check to Tumble through a creature's space. On a success, the mouths of the cluster gnash and gnaw at the creature, dealing 3d8 Piercing Damage damage. If the Acrobatics check was a critical success, the target also takes 4 Bleed Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Detach Cluster
offensiveAbilities.description: The caypin detaches half of its facial appendages into an appendage cluster that occupies a single adjacent square of its choice. A caypin can have up to two appendage clusters detached at a time, and if both clusters are detached, the caypin can't make jaws Strikes or Detach Cluster again until at least one cluster reattaches. An adjacent appendage cluster can reattach to the caypin with an Interact action.
